summary: Prospect Lake Water, L.P. is the exact project company for Fort Lauderdale's Prospect Lake Clean Water Center. Direct current sources verify the project-company and facility boundary, Prospect Lake Holdings, L.P. as current general partner, the Ridgewood Fund II general-partner chain, Prospect Lake Holdings and IDE PLCWC, Inc. as the 2023 contract's Equity Providers with 75-percent and 25-percent contractual Percentage Interests, City ownership of the site and plant, and advanced commissioning before the September 8, 2026 target COD. They do not disclose the complete cutoff-current PLW partner and security-holder register, establish that the contract Percentage Interests remained the legal equity stakes at cutoff, prove IDE PLCWC's direct-LP status, supply PLH or IDE shareholder ledgers, or expose the substance and ownership effect of the July 31, 2026 LP amendment. The September 2 City memorandum did not establish COD or Final Acceptance by September 5. Publishing either a current owner after-image or an operating label would require inference, so the only safe terminal outcome is a fresh exact deferral.
resolvedFormerBlockers: The project identity and boundary are resolved: Prospect Lake Water, L.P. is the Delaware project-company SPE for the Prospect Lake Clean Water Center at 5900 Hawkins Road, while the Center is the facility, Prospect Lake Holdings, L.P. is the general-partner and equity-provider vehicle, IDE PLCWC, Inc. is a named equity provider and PLCWC O&M, LLC is the operator.

The executed 2023 Comprehensive Agreement verifies Prospect Lake Holdings, L.P. and IDE PLCWC, Inc. as Equity Providers with 75-percent and 25-percent contractual Percentage Interests and pro-rata contribution obligations. Those terms are preserved as historic contract facts and are not promoted to a complete cutoff-current legal ownership schedule.

The current Florida record verifies Prospect Lake Holdings, L.P. as PLW's current general partner and the July 31, 2026 LP amendment as the latest indexed event. The current PLH record identifies Ridgewood Water & Strategic Infrastructure Fund II, L.P. as PLH's general partner, and the SEC Form D/A verifies the Ridgewood Fund II GP and manager chain.

The City, project company, construction, O&M, technology, property and financing boundaries are resolved sufficiently to prevent duplicate companies or false owners. City ownership of the site and plant, Kiewit's design-build role, PLCWC O&M and IDE operating or technology roles, lenders, subordinate financing, Fiveash and other suppliers are not treated as company equity.

The cutoff operating state is resolved as advanced commissioning before COD. The September 2 City memorandum says operations were anticipated in September, reports a September 8 target COD and continued evaluation of contractual, regulatory, commissioning and operating requirements. It does not establish COD, Final Acceptance or start of the 30-year operating term by September 5.

identityResolution.collisionResult: Count Prospect Lake Water, L.P. once as the manager-level project company. Prospect Lake Holdings, L.P. and IDE PLCWC, Inc. are chain and equity-provider vehicles, PLCWC O&M, LLC is the operator, RI Flamingo Holdings and IDE Americas were prior proposers, and the City, Kiewit, Fiveash, lenders, suppliers and unrelated Prospect Lake names are not duplicate PortCos or owners.

ownershipResolution.executedAgreement: The 2023-02-14 executed Comprehensive Agreement names Prospect Lake Holdings, L.P. and IDE PLCWC, Inc. as Equity Providers, assigns 75-percent and 25-percent contractual Percentage Interests and requires pro-rata contributions. It does not identify IDE PLCWC as a PLW limited partner, disclose units, votes or the complete capitalization, or prove that those percentages remained legal equity at the 2026-09-05 cutoff.
ownershipResolution.generalPartnerChain: The current Florida records verify PLW -> general partner Prospect Lake Holdings, L.P. -> general partner Ridgewood Water & Strategic Infrastructure Fund II, L.P. The SEC Form D/A verifies Fund II -> Ridgewood Infrastructure Fund II GP, LLC -> manager Ridgewood Infrastructure, LLC. PLH limited partners, Fund II's economic PLH interest, the GP-LLC members, units, votes and control rights remain undisclosed.
ownershipResolution.julyAmendment: The current Florida detail page identifies LP AMENDMENT filed 2026-07-31 as PLW's latest event and links a five-page image PDF. The PDF rendered in the current browser without an accessible text layer, while command-line access returned a challenge response. The amendment's substantive terms, partner changes, governance changes and ownership effects were not certified; an unchanged public index cannot prove that no ownership change occurred.
ownershipResolution.ideChain: IDE PLCWC, Inc. is directly named as a 2023 Equity Provider and IDE Technologies attribution is supported, but its legal parent and shareholder chain, direct-LP status, stock ownership, cutoff stake, votes, governance and control are not published in the current direct record.
prohibitedInferences: Do not infer that the 2023 contract's 75-percent and 25-percent Percentage Interests are the complete cutoff-current legal equity stakes, limited-partner interests, votes or control rights.

Do not infer equal or controlling stakes from joint sponsorship, combined project-team capital contribution, board or management roles, fund attribution, chronology, current portfolio-page inclusion or silence.
Do not infer that the July 31, 2026 amendment had no partner, governance or ownership effect from the unchanged Florida index, addresses or displayed general partner.
Do not infer IDE PLCWC's direct-LP status or complete IDE shareholder chain from its Equity Provider, operator or technology role.
Do not treat the City, Kiewit, PLCWC O&M, IDE operating entities, lenders, subordinate financing, suppliers, Fiveash, consultants or regulators as PLW equity holders absent direct proof.

operatingResolution.profile: Prospect Lake Clean Water Center is a 50-MGD potable-water treatment plant using nanofiltration and ion exchange. The City owns the site and plant; PLW has project delivery, availability and 30-year O&M obligations under the Comprehensive Agreement.
operatingResolution.cutoff: The September 2, 2026 City memorandum says the project remained on schedule for September operations, reports that PLW submitted an August 3 COD notice targeting September 8 and says the City continued to evaluate contractual, regulatory, commissioning and operating requirements. No accepted test certificate, FDEP clearance, City COD acknowledgment, Final Acceptance or operating-term commencement was found through September 5.
operatingResolution.boundary: Keep construction, commissioning, regulatory approval, property ownership, O&M, technology, debt and supplier roles separate from both company ownership and legal commercial-operation status.

transactionResolution.laterCheck: No later public equity issuance, transfer, recapitalization, general-partner replacement, merger, sponsor exit, new investor, control change or signed pending ownership transaction was found through 2026-09-05. The 2024 and 2026 LP amendment images, amended LP agreement and private holder and transfer ledgers remain required; absence of another public event is not proof of ownership continuity.
transactionResolution.nonEquity: City approvals, site and plant ownership, concession and project-agreement rights, Kiewit construction, IDE and PLCWC O&M operating or technology roles, lenders, subordinate instruments, construction changes, commissioning and Fiveash or supplier relationships do not establish PLW or PLH equity ownership.

applicationRequirements: Use a terminal-only DEFERRED outcome and do not create or correct Prospect Lake company ownership or operating status while the complete cutoff-current ownership after-image, July 31, 2026 amendment substance and accepted COD remain unavailable.

Preserve the verified project-company identity, facility and chain boundaries, 2023 Equity Provider contract terms, current Florida general-partner chain, Ridgewood Fund II manager chain and pre-COD commissioning state as research lineage.

Do not assign 75-percent and 25-percent as cutoff legal ownership, create separate holdco or operator PortCos, infer IDE direct-LP status, infer an unchanged amendment, or mark operating from a target date, progress report, financing or silence.

Use exactly one application primary citation bound to the fresh current executed Comprehensive Agreement bytes; retain both Florida records, the Form D/A, City memorandum and amendment URL as supporting current research lineage.
